Hakuna Matata by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In a gorgeous community with a stunning pool and tennis courts, welcome to Hakuna Matata. With two bikes included, you can cruise up and down 30A with ease. The beach is just a quick 0.7-mile ride away, so you’ll be soaking up the sun in no time. The perfect spot for your next beach getaway, the charming home has 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a bright, spacious kitchen and dining area—plenty of room for relaxing or gathering with friends and family. Step inside and enjoy the open, airy layout, with a cozy screened-in porch, perfect for morning coffee or evening chats. The kitchen is designed for both style and function, with a large island for meal prep or just hanging out. On the first floor, the primary suite features a king bed and an elegant bathroom, and there’s even a convenient washer and dryer, plus a wine cooler for those beachy evenings in. Upstairs, two more bedrooms await—one with a queen bed and the other with a king—connected by a shared bathroom, making it a great setup for guests or kids. When you’re ready to explore, local dining favorites are just minutes away.

Angelina’s Pizzeria is a must for pizza lovers, while 723 Whiskey Bravo is the go-to for burgers, seafood, and steak. Don’t miss out on Amavida Coffee and Tea or Great Southern Café, perfect for fueling up before another day of 30A adventures! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line.
